v1.notes: Registry has executionSurface but no router signal, fusion lane, or executor identity.

v2.notes: Raw v2 has lane and executor, but no router signal; its LEXICAL/STRUCTURAL/SEMANTIC/GRAPH/DOC lane enum is not SearchRuntime's fusion-lane type. Capability module also combines pure snapshot construction with live probing.

v2Review.notes: Isolated review candidate explicitly separates routerSignal, logicalLane, and executor; router signals are validated against router-matrix.ts and logicalLane is typed from SearchRuntime. Fixture proof only; owner mappings are not promoted.

fusionOwner.scopeLimit: Direct multi-executor fixture proves Qdrant and TurboVec collapse to one dense-lane contribution; it does not separately prove cuVS/CAGRA production mappings.

mappingFindings.notes: SearchRuntime currently exposes graph/docs neither as fusion lane IDs nor an alias here; rg_keyword maps to rg, distinct from lexical. Do not encode the proposed conceptual lane list as if it were the current fusion owner.

recommendation: Use the isolated v2-review three-layer shape as the contract candidate, but keep promotion blocked until each helper has an owner-verified routerSignal, an explicit mapping to the existing SearchRuntime lane set (or a separately reviewed lane-owner change), and a real executor identity. Preserve one-vote-per-lane fusion.
